name: world.pdata/mcp
title: pdata Prediction Markets
description: 12 public venues including Polymarket and Kalshi. Live odds, volume and movers. Read-only, no auth.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Use when finding prediction-market event IDs and citation links for research.

query.description: Words from an event title or market question.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description:
Use when retrieving a citable Markdown brief for a known prediction-market event.

Keep the quote-tier labels when citing prices from the brief.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Use when browsing events. Shows leading outcome, price, volume and event link. Use get_event for market rows. Search also matches market questions. Check `quote_tier` in get_event or get_market before quoting.

view.description: Lean updated_at appears only without changed_at.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Must match limit if both are supplied.

limit.description: Alias for page_size. Both values must agree.

source.description: Venue IDs as CSV. See get_status for public IDs.

active.description: True for open, false for closed.

hide_ended.description: Exclude past end dates, keeping undated rows.

created_after.description: First seen by pdata ≥ this ISO 8601 time.

created_before.description: First seen by pdata ≤ this ISO 8601 time.

search.description: English stems, case/accent insensitive. Use or, "phrases", -exclude. Typos may match. 1–2 letter terms match whole words. Alone they match titles/questions only.

sort.description: closed_time, created_at, end_date, liquidity, normalized_vol_24hr, normalized_volume, updated_at, volume, volume_24h_change, volume_24hr. Prefix - for descending. Default -normalized_vol_24hr.

include_uncountried.description: Also include rows without country tags.

country_match.description: Match any (OR) or all (AND) selected countries.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Use when getting an event by source and event ID. Read `kind` first. Live records include all markets by default. Events archived after 10 days return a tombstone with final outcomes at the same URL. Check `quote_tier`. Label non-firm prices by tier.

source.description: Single venue ID. See get_status for public IDs.

event_id.description: Event ID native to the source. URL-encoded if it contains special chars.

markets_limit.description: First N live markets. markets_total counts all. Ignored for tombstones.

tools.name: get_event_brief
tools.description: Use when reading the compact form of get_event, including archived events. Up to 20 outcomes (leaders live, results first once closed), with the first outcome's rules. Untraded prices are absent. Winners require confirmation. `priced_outcome` names the priced side for non-Yes/No rows. See `cite_as` and `data_as_of`. Use get_event for full rows. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana. Check `quote_tier` in get_event or get_market before quoting.

source.description: Single venue ID. See get_status for public IDs.

event_id.description: Event ID native to the source. URL-encoded if it contains special chars.

format.description: Response format. JSON is the default.

tools.name: get_event_history
tools.description: Use when charting market probabilities or 24h volume for an event. Bounded windows carry the last prior snapshot forward. Kalshi market tickers select that market in its parent event's history.

event_id.description: Event id native to the source. A market ticker that extends its event id redirects to that event.

market_id.description: Include this market even if it ranks outside the top set.

limit.description: Top-K markets, clamped to 1–50. markets_limit takes precedence.

max_points.description: Target maximum per series. Price gaps and endpoints are retained even when they exceed this number. Sampling can omit volume observations.

markets_limit.description: Maximum series including market_id. Takes precedence over limit.

page_size.description: Alias for limit. Both values must agree.

tools.name: get_event_similar
tools.description: Use when finding cross-venue matches or related events. Nightly title embeddings, best first. Empty when no similarities are known. Check `quote_tier` in get_event or get_market before quoting.

event_id.description: Event id native to the source.

page_size.description: Alias for limit. Both values must agree.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: Use when getting a market by source and market ID. Includes parent event, chart and citation. Read `kind` first. Tombstones give last observations and known results after archive at 10 days past event close. Archives before late November 2026 return 404. Try get_event. Check `quote_tier`. Label non-firm prices by tier.

source.description: Single venue ID. See get_status for public IDs.

market_id.description: Market ID native to the source. Composite key with `source`.

tools.name: get_markets
tools.description: Use when getting listing rows for up to 50 market keys. Input order, duplicates removed. Keys absent from public listings appear in `not_found`. Use get_market for archives. Check `quote_tier`. Label non-firm prices by tier.

tools.name: top_movers
tools.description: Use when ranking absolute 24h moves (use `list_news_movers` or `news_movers_by_category` for weighted spikes). One open market per event. Requires >2 points and >$1,000 equivalent 24h volume. A traded 24h baseline is required, so first trades and markets listed under 24h ago are excluded. `include_short_lived=true` allows contracts lasting ≤24h, still subject to those checks. Climate and Weather and Mentions are excluded. `hide_price_derivatives=false` opts in. Each group of 5 has up to 2 Polymarket, 1 Kalshi, 1 Manifold and 1 other-venue market, with unused slots filled by any venue. `meta.total` counts returned rows. Check `quote_tier`. Label non-firm prices by tier.

tools.name: search_suggest
tools.description: Use when finding event or market IDs by name. Best first. Use `event_path` for links and `title` for clean text. `headline` has highlights. Weak matches may retry with shorter full text. “Goes public” and “going public” also match IPO titles. Check `quote_tier` in get_event or get_market before quoting.

q.description: Event title or market question. Under 2 characters returns no hits.

limit.description: Max hits. total_events/total_markets count matches separately. _meta.total_capped flags a lower bound.

page_size.description: Alias for limit. Both values must agree.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Use when comparing activity across venues. `source_sync` gives listing clocks even without summary figures. Totals scope is gemini, kalshi, limitless, manifold, myriad, opinion, polymarket, predict. `grand_total_volume_24hr` sums measured real-money totals and omits dated exclusions. See `missing_volume_sources` and `unavailable_sources`. Volume is in US dollars (notional: one share or contract pays $1) except on Manifold, which uses play-money mana.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description:
Use when checking venue freshness and coverage. Returns the latest completed listing
cycle, typical period, late flag, census coverage and totals eligibility for each public
venue, plus the serving API version.

tools.description: Use when finding valid country tags and their market counts. Selected countries affect counts in AND mode. Defaults to venues eligible for totals.

tools.name: list_news_movers
tools.description: Use when finding news spikes by event/topic (use `top_movers` for 24h moves or `news_movers_by_category` for categories). Score = absolute move × log10(1 + USD-equivalent volume). Prices use 0–100. `d_prob` is signed points over the window and `prob_history` always covers 24h. Refreshed after Polymarket ingest. Defaults to totals venues. Pass source for a venue-only feed. Market `pdata_url` links to its event, if any.

source.description: Venue IDs as CSV. See get_status for public IDs.

categories.description: Category filter (CSV). Examples: 'Politics', 'Sports', 'Crypto', 'Weather'. Maps to events.categories assignments.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring in market or event title.

include_resolved.description: Include qualifying closes from the last 24h.

ordering.title: NewsOrdering
ordering.description: Sort by USD-equivalent volume (vol, the default), spike score (score), or absolute probability change (d_prob, also called prob or recent).

window.title: SpikeWindow
window.description: Minimum move is 10pp for 2h, 12pp for 12h, 15pp for 24h.

page_size.description: Rows per page. Must match limit if both are supplied.

limit.description: Alias for page_size. Both values must agree.

tools.name: news_movers_by_category
tools.description: Use when grouping `list_news_movers` by category (use `top_movers` for 24h moves). Same scope and clusters across 13 categories, excluding Mentions.

source.description: Venue IDs as CSV. See get_status for public IDs.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring in market or event title.

include_resolved.description: Include qualifying closes from the last 24h.

per_category.description: Max items per category bucket (1-50; default 11).

limit.description: Alias for per_category. Supplied sizes must agree.

page_size.description: Alias for per_category. Supplied sizes must agree.

tools.name: map_heat
tools.description: Use when mapping country attention now or by past hour. Sums news scores for 24h movers, capped at 100 per market. Default scope is cross-venue totals sources. All-source volume omits play money. See `volume_unavailable` for missing figures.

at.description: 'now' (live cache) or an ISO-8601 timestamp for a past hourly frame.

source.description: Venue ID for at=now. See get_status for public IDs.

tools.name: map_timeline
tools.description: Use when you need the hourly total-heat time series: one point per hour, `total` being the sum of every country's heat at that hour (heat as defined in map_heat). History accretes from launch (no backfill); the whole series comes in one response, with no paging, and grows by one point an hour.

source.description: Reserved; playback history is source_scope='all' in v1.

tools.name: compare_pairs
tools.description: Use when comparing odds for supported pairs (Kalshi and Polymarket). Largest gaps first. Matches title words and Yes/No shape or outcome name. Pairs without two firm quotes count in `matched` only. Check both venues' resolution rules.

left.description: First venue. Supported pair: polymarket and kalshi, in either order.

limit.description: Max pairs to return, largest gap first (1-200).

page_size.description: Alias for limit. Both values must agree.
